description:
**Phase E — Compaction orchestration. Deps: B6.**

Per upstream pattern: compaction NEVER mutates the message log; the kept-window is computed at prompt-assembly time via `build_session_context`.

Today, `OctoPi.Agent.Loop` dumps `MessageLog.to_list/1` to the LLM. After this ticket, `Loop` instead asks `Session` for the post-compaction message list. `Session` delegates to `SessionManager.build_session_context/2` (B6) which respects the most recent `CompactionEntry`'s `firstKeptEntryId` and injects the synthetic summary message.

This preserves `MessageLog` as append-only (current API: push/append_many/to_list/count) — no new mutation methods needed.

Tests: integration test confirming Loop receives the rebuilt list after a compaction is appended.
title: E5a. Loop reads from Session.build_session_context/0 (upstream pattern)
